script.title: AT THE BAGGAGE DESK
script.story_hook: One tired traveler is missing a big blue suitcase.
script.intro_zh: 一位疲憊的旅客，少了一個藍色大行李箱。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today we report a delayed bag at an airport desk. Listen for polite claim questions.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天我們在機場櫃檯申報延誤行李。留意有禮貌的求助問句。
script.outro: Signed, reported, hopeful. See you at the desk!
script.outro_zh: 簽好單、報好案，希望就在路上。櫃檯再見！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each airport desk phrase.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，我們逐句跟讀機場櫃檯常用句。
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her twenties with long straight black hair in a ponytail, wearing an olive green parka over a gray hoodie, dark jeans and white sneakers, slim build, looking exhausted
script.char_b_description: a middle-aged man in his forties with short neatly combed brown hair and small round glasses, wearing a navy airline vest over a white shirt, black slacks and polished shoes, stocky and calm

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, sorry to bother you. My flight just landed.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ˈsɑɹi tə ˈbɑɹə ju maɪ flɑɪt dʒʌst ˈlændɪd/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，打擾了。我的班機剛抵達。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem! Did any bags come out?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm dɪd ˈɛni bæɡz kʌm aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題！有行李箱出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bag never came out. It's big and blue.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bæɡ ˈnɛvɚ kmeɪt aʊt ɪts bɪɡ ænd blu/
dialogue.zh: 我的行李根本沒出來。是藍色大箱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I'm sorry. Do you have the claim tag?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪm ˈsɑɹi du ju hæv ðə kleɪm tæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 好的，很抱歉。有行李牌的號碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right here. The number is B seven six two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt hɪɹ ðə ˈnʌmbɚ ɪz bi ˈsɛvən sɪks tu/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡。號碼是B七六二。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. What was in the suitcase, roughly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt wʌt wəz ɪn ðə ˈsutˌkeɪs ˈɹʌfli/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。箱子裡大概有什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clothes, my laptop, and a gift for my kid.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊðz maɪ ˈlæptˌɑp ænd ə ˈɡɪf fɚ maɪ ˈkɪd/
dialogue.zh: 衣服、筆電，還有給孩子的一盒禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any medicine or valuables inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni ˈmɛdəsən ɔɹ væˈljuəbl̩z ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 裡面有藥品或貴重物品嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, my medicine! That's in there, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm maɪ ˈmɛdəsən ðæts ɪn ðɛr tu/
dialogue.zh: 呃，我的藥也在裡面，慘了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, medicine first. Do you need it tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ˈmɛdəsən fɜɹst du ju nid ɪt təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好，先顧藥。今晚就需要嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, honestly. Can we open the bag fast?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈɑnəstli kæn wi ˈoʊpən ðə bæɡ fæst/
dialogue.zh: 對，說真的。能趕快開箱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can't, I'm afraid. Bags go through customs.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kænt aɪm əˈfɹeɪd bæɡs ɡoʊ θɹu ˈkʌstəmz/
dialogue.zh: 恐怕不行。行李還得經過海關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Customs? So when will it reach me?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌstəmz soʊ wɛn wɪl ɪt ɹitʃ mi/
dialogue.zh: 海關？那什麼時候能交回我手上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If it's found tonight, it arrives by noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf ɪs faʊnd təˈnaɪt ɪt əˈɹaɪvz baɪ nun/
dialogue.zh: 今晚找到的話，中午就能送到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By noon… okay. But we leave Sunday morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ nun oʊˈkeɪ bʌt wi liv ˈsʌndeɪ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 中午…好吧。不過我們週日一早就走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let's fix that. Where are you staying?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛts fɪks ðæt wɛɹ ju steɪɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那我們來想辦法。你們住在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maple Hotel, room 512, downtown near the park.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪpəl hoʊˈtɛl ɹum faɪvˈtwɛlv daʊnˈtaʊn nɪɹ ðə pɑɹk/
dialogue.zh: 楓樹飯店，512房，在市中心公園附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, that's on my screen already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt ðæts ɑn maɪ skɹin ɔlˈɹɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，螢幕上已經看得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow. Will someone bring it to the hotel?
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ wɪl ˈsʌmwʌn bɹɪŋ ɪt tə ðə hoʊˈtɛl/
dialogue.zh: 哇。會有人送到飯店嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we courier it. Just sign this form.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wi ˈkʊɹiɚ ɪt dʒʌst saɪn ðɪs fɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 會的，我們派人送。請簽這張單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure. Um, is delivery free for delayed bags?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ʌm ɪz dɪˈlɪvɚi fɹi fɚ dɪˈleɪd bæɡz/
dialogue.zh: 好。呃，延誤行李的運費是免費的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is. And keep receipts for the essentials.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ænd kip ɹɪˈsits fɚ ði əˈsɛnʃəlz/
dialogue.zh: 是免費的。買日用品的收據要留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Essentials? You mean I can buy things now?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈsɛnʃəlz ju min aɪ kæn baɪ θɪŋz naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 日用品？所以我現在可以先去買東西？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Toothbrush, socks, whatever you need tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtuθˌbɹʌʃ sɑks wʌtˈɛvɚ ju nid təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 牙刷、襪子，今晚缺什麼就買什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That helps a lot, honestly. Where do I shop?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt hɛlps ə lɑt ˈɑnəstli wɛɹ du aɪ ʃɑp/
dialogue.zh: 幫了大忙了，說真的。在哪裡買好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ground floor, past security. It's cheaper there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹaʊnd flɔɹ pæst sɪˈkjʊɹəti ɪts ˈtʃipɚ ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 樓下，安檢過後那一區比較便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. So what happens after I sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt soʊ wʌt ˈhæpənz ˈæftɚ aɪ saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好。那我簽完之後呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You get a claim number: D-L four nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɡɛt ə kleɪm ˈnʌmbɚ di ˈɛl fɔɹ naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 你會拿到一個追蹤編號：D-L四九。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: D-L four nine. I'll save it in my phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /di ˈɛl fɔɹ naɪn aɪl seɪv ɪt ɪn maɪ foʊn/
dialogue.zh: D-L四九。我存在手機裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea. We text updates, too, by the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə wi tɛkst ˈəpˌdeɪts tu baɪ ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。對了，我們也會傳訊息通知。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. One silly question — what if it's lost?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs wʌn ˈsɪli ˈkwɛsʧən wʌt ɪf ɪs lɔst/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。呃，問個傻問題…真的找不到怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not silly. After five days, we start a claim.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑɾ ˈsɪli ˈæftɚ faɪv deɪz wi stɑɹt ə kleɪm/
dialogue.zh: 才不傻。五天後我們會申請賠償。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five days. Okay… I really love that suitcase.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv deɪz oʊˈkeɪ aɪ ˈɹɪli lʌv ðæt ˈsutˌkeɪs/
dialogue.zh: 五天。好吧…我真的很愛那個行李箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was a gift? Well, let's hope for noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wəz ə ɡɪf wɛl lɛts hoʊp fɚ nun/
dialogue.zh: 是禮物？那我們一起盼中午的消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Actually, my sister gave it. So, nervous, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæktʃuəli maɪ ˈsɪstɚ ɡeɪv ɪt soʊ ˈnɜɹvəs jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 其實是我姊送的。所以，嗯，難免緊張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Understood. Hey, it might already be on the next flight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndɚˈstʊd heɪ ɪt maɪt ɔlˈɹɛdi bi ɑn ðə nɛkst flɑɪt/
dialogue.zh: 了解。嘿，說不定它已經在下一班飛機上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? When does that one land?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪli wɛn dʌz ðæt wʌn lænd/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？那班幾點到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten forty tonight. Bags sort by midnight.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈfɔɹti təˈnaɪt bæɡz sɔɹt baɪ ˈmaɪdˌnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚十點四十。行李半夜前會分完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh! So noon is very possible.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ soʊ nun ɪz ˈvɛɹi ˈpɑsəbl̩/
dialogue.zh: 啊！那中午很有可能送到！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. You may even beat your bag home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ju meɪ ˈivən bit jʊɹ bæɡ hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 就是說啊。說不定你比行李先到家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! I'd love that. My kid wants her toy.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪd lʌv ðæt maɪ ˈkɪd wɑntɚ ˈtɔɪ/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，希望如此。我孩子還想要她的玩具。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A toy in a blue case — I'll note it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə tɔɪ ɪn ə blu keɪs aɪl noʊt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 藍箱子裡有玩具，我幫你寫進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please. And the medicine is in the side pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz ænd ðə ˈmɛdəsən ɪz ɪn ðə saɪd ˈpɑkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 麻煩了。藥放在側邊的口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Side pocket noted, in bold. Anything else?
dialogue.phonetic: /saɪd ˈpɑkɪt ˈnoʊtɪd ɪn boʊld ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls/
dialogue.zh: 側邊口袋，我用粗體標上。還有別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um… can I call this desk if it's late?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm kæn aɪ kɔl ðɪs dɛsk ɪf ɪs leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 呃…如果中午沒送到，能打這個櫃檯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. The number's printed on your form.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv ˈkɔɹs ðə ˈnʌmbɚz ˈprɪntɪd ɑn jʊɹ fɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 當然。號碼就印在你那張單上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Oh — one more small thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt oʊ wʌn mɔɹ smɑl θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 收到了。噢，還有一件小事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, go ahead. We have time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ɡoʊ əˈhɛd wi hæv taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 你說，我們還有時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My husband's bag came out, so we're okay tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈhʌzbəndz bæɡ kmeɪt aʊt soʊ wiɹ ˈoʊkeɪ təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我先生的箱子已經到了，所以今晚沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's good news. Shared closet, no panic.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɡʊd nuz ʃɛɹd ˈklɑzɪt noʊ ˈpænɪk/
dialogue.zh: 那就好。兩個人共用一個櫃子，不慌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right! He's already unpacking at the hotel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt hiz ɔlˈɹɛdi ʌnˈpækɪŋ æt ðə hoʊˈtɛl/
dialogue.zh: 對！他現在已經在飯店拆行李了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? This is the easy part of travel.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ðɪs ɪz ði ˈizi pɑɹt ʌv ˈtɹævl̩/
dialogue.zh: 看吧，這就是旅行裡輕鬆的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Easy for you, maybe. This is my first time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizi fɚ ju ˈmeɪbi ðɪs ɪz maɪ fɜɹst taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 你說容易，我這可是第一次呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First lost bag? You handled it perfectly.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜɹst lɔst bæɡ ju ˈhændəld ɪt ˈpɜɹfɪktli/
dialogue.zh: 第一次行李延誤？你處理得很棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks. Signing now… done. Anything for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks ˈsaɪnɪŋ naʊ dʌn ˈɛniθɪŋ fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。我現在簽名…好了。還要我做什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep this copy. Questions? Call the desk line.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðɪs ˈkɑpi ˈkwɛsʧənz kɔl ðə dɛsk laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 收好這份複印本。有問題就打櫃檯專線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will do. Is there coffee near the exit?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl du ɪz ðɛɹ ˈkɔfi nɪɹ ði ˈɛɡzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好的。出口附近有咖啡廳嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two doors left, and the pretzels are free.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu dɔɹz lɛft ænd ðə ˈpɹɛtsəlz ɑɹ fɹi/
dialogue.zh: 走兩步就到，扭結餅乾還免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free? Well… see you tomorrow, maybe!
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹi wɛl si ju təˈmɑɹoʊ ˈmeɪbi/
dialogue.zh: 免費？那…明天見囉，說不定！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Bye! Watch for a text before noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ baɪ wɑtʃ fɚ ə tɛkst bɪˈfɔɹ nun/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，拜拜！中午前留意你的訊息。

60句機場聽力練習：轉盤上的行李一顆顆出現，藍色大箱子卻怎麼等都不來，該怎麼辦？

這一集跟著一位剛下飛機的旅客，走到行李服務櫃檯，學會報遺失、填單、留飯店地址，還有今晚買備品的錢該由誰付、收據怎麼留。

你會聽到：
- 報延誤行李的開場問句
- 描述行李與行李牌號碼的說法
- 送貨到飯店、留追蹤編號的用法
- 買牙刷襪子等備品、留收據報銷的詞

60 lines of airport listening practice: the carousel empties out, but one big blue suitcase never comes, so a tired traveler files a report at the airline desk.

You will hear how to report a delayed bag, describe it with its claim tag, ask for free hotel delivery, buy an essentials kit with receipts, and follow up politely. The second half is line-by-line listening and shadowing.

Made for A2 learners: no memorizing, just listen until it sticks.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
轉盤上的行李都領完了，你的藍色大箱子卻不見了，該找誰？

這一集帶大家走進深夜的機場行李服務櫃檯，跟著一位疲憊的旅客和冷定的航空公司服務人員，從填提領單到送貨到飯店，把申報延誤行李的每一步聽懂、說會。

你會聽到：
🧳 申報開場：「My bag never came out. It's big and blue.」
🏨 送貨安排：「Yes, we courier it. Just sign this form.」
🧴 買備品：「Toothbrush, socks, whatever you need tonight.」

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧 先把整段對話聽熟，再一句一句開口模仿，讓句子自然變成口語習慣。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

祝你每次降落，行李都比你先到。
script.thumbnail_action: holding up a baggage claim tag
